description: Writes and reviews concise executable engineering plans that reuse canonical PRD product authority when available, fall back to a protected local decision baseline only when needed, and enforce evidence-driven work units, phase decision audits, and rollback-aware execution.

changes: Require every Standard and Full plan phase to be independently verifiable before the next phase starts.
Forbid inverted phase dependencies where a later phase is needed to close an earlier phase.
Require each phase gate to record completion status, residual risk, user approval status, and a proceed or pause decision.
Add strict phase-gate fixtures, exemplar coverage, and sanity checks.
